name: @aibast-agents-library/field-service-dispatch
sales_headline: Convert service requests, zone capacity, and skill evidence into dispatcher-reviewed options.
card_pitch: Turns a synthetic dispatch snapshot into prioritized, reviewable options while leaving every job, route, message, and field action unchanged.
customer_challenge: Manual dispatch coordination delays response and obscures crew capacity, job progress, and customer communication.
business_value: Turns a synthetic dispatch snapshot into prioritized, reviewable options while leaving every job, route, message, and field action unchanged.
why_try: Use the synthetic cases to evaluate routing, evidence quality, and approval boundaries before connecting customer systems.
safety_note: Decision support only; production writes require authenticated tools and explicit authorized human approval.
